$comment: BC Ferries: the operator of the bc-ferries feed (config/feeds/bc-ferries/). Its vessels are far bigger and faster than SeaBus, which the ferry defaults are for (config/defaults/kinematics.json). These are the minor routes' vessels; routes.json gives the major routes' bigger ones.
name: BC Ferries

ferry.$maxSpeed: km/h. Island and Salish class vessels, the minor routes', service speeds about 14-15 knots (BC Ferries fleet pages, https://www.bcferries.com/on-the-ferry/our-fleet, checked 2026-10-28; guess within that).
ferry.$length: m. Island class 81 m, Salish class 107 m: a middle value (guess). Drawn to scale, so the length shows at station zoom.
ferry.$accel: m/s². Ships take a few minutes to reach speed (guess).
